text: Dish: Recipe. Cuisine: Goan. Ingredients: kashmiri chillies, whole garlic, whole ginger, whole cumin, coconut flour, dry coconut, khokra, sugar, jaggery, tamarind, dry kokum, turmeric, salt, fish. Steps: Combine the dry chopped kashmiri chillies, whole garlic, whole ginger, whole cumin, and coconut flour in a mixer. Process the mixture until it forms a smooth paste. Add coconut flour, sugar, jaggery, tamarind, kokum, turmeric, and salt to the paste. Mix all ingredients thoroughly until well combined. Cut the fish into desired pieces for cooking. Prepare the masala according to the recipe instructions. Heat the prepared masala in a pan over medium heat. Stir frequently to ensure even distribution of flavors and prevent burning..
